label: The stack as an RC ladder
section: The stack as an RC ladder
subgoals: Model each on transistor in the stack as a resistance
Place a diffusion capacitance at every internal node and the output
Root the RC chain at ground for a falling transition

label: Elmore delay of the falling output
section: Elmore delay of the falling output
subgoals: Weight each internal node's capacitance by its resistance to ground
Weight the output capacitance by the full stack resistance
Sum the terms to get the worst-case falling delay

label: Input ordering and pin-dependent delay
subgoals: Identify which internal nodes are already discharged when the last input arrives
Remove their terms when the latest input drives the top transistor
Connect the asymmetry to per-pin arcs and pin swapping
